_about: Every third-party component in Platen Reader, the one list both THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md and the apps' Acknowledgements are made from (scripts/make-acknowledgements.py). Add or change a component here, put its licence text in Licenses/texts/, and run the script. 'shipped' is 'app' (inside the macOS and iOS apps) or 'voice' (in the natural-voice pack, downloaded only when the reader asks).

components.name: foliate-js
components.included: Vendored JavaScript in PlatenReader/Web/foliate, bundled in both apps; draws books in the reader's web view.

components.name: fflate
components.version: the minified build vendored by foliate-js at commit 78914ae (the file does not state its version)
components.included: Vendored JavaScript in PlatenReader/Web/foliate/vendor/fflate.js, bundled in both apps; decompresses MOBI and AZW3 text.

components.name: MisakiSwift
components.version: commit b7477b1, modified (no MLX; Platen's own fallback for unknown words)
components.notice: MisakiSwift by mlalma (Swift port of hexgrad/misaki). Changes by Platen: no MLX, lexicons read from the voice pack, an English fallback without a neural network.
components.included: Vendored Swift source in PlatenReader/Shared/Kokoro/Misaki, compiled into both apps; turns English text into the sounds Kokoro speaks.

components.name: MLXUtilsLibrary (token type)
components.included: Vendored Swift source in PlatenReader/Shared/Kokoro/Misaki/MToken.swift, compiled into both apps.

components.name: Misaki (G2P method)
components.notice: Misaki by hexgrad: the English grapheme-to-phoneme method MisakiSwift ports.
components.included: Through MisakiSwift (above); its lexicons are in the voice pack (below).

components.name: Kokoro (model code)
components.version: the PyTorch model (model.py, modules.py, istftnet.py), ported to Swift
components.notice: Kokoro by hexgrad. Platen runs the model with its own Swift code on Accelerate (PlatenCore/Sources/Kokoro/KokoroModel.swift), a port of this code.
components.included: Ported (not copied) into PlatenCore's Kokoro module, compiled into both apps.

components.name: Kokoro-82M (weights and voices)
components.version: v1.0; weights at Hugging Face commit f3ff357, converted to 8-bit integers by Platen; voices as exported by onnx-community at commit 1939ad2
components.included: In the natural-voice pack (kokoro-weights.bin, voices/), downloaded from Platen's GitHub release only when the reader asks; built by scripts/make-kokoro-pack.py from pinned, hashed sources.

components.name: Misaki English lexicons
components.included: In the natural-voice pack, downloaded only when the reader asks.

components.name: CMU Pronouncing Dictionary
components.notice: Copyright (C) 1993-2015 Carnegie Mellon University. All rights reserved.
components.included: In the natural-voice pack (cmudict.dict), downloaded only when the reader asks; pronounces words the Misaki lexicons lack.

notes: Spelling-to-sound rules for words no dictionary has (PlatenReader/Shared/Kokoro/KokoroLetterRules.swift) were written for Platen after the method of Elovitz, Johnson, McHugh and Shore (US Naval Research Laboratory, 1976), a US government work in the public domain.
No GPL or LGPL code or data is used. In particular, eSpeak NG (GPL-3.0) is not bundled, linked or called, not even as a fallback for unknown words.
Apple's frameworks (WebKit, PDFKit, AVFoundation, NaturalLanguage, Accelerate and others) and Apple's voices are part of the operating system, not shipped with Platen.
The app icon is Platen's own (design/icon/make-icons.py). No third-party fonts or icons are bundled; the reader uses the system's fonts and SF Symbols.

Not shipped: the untracked Vendor/ folder (ONNX Runtime, from a trial that was dropped) is not referenced by the Xcode project, and scripts/make-kokoro-pack.py's numpy runs only on the developer's machine.
